messages:
aanya: quick sync — trying to land NOVA-small into staging. need: weights path + perms, tokenizer quirk (weird truncation on tool args), and a quick golden/toolcall smoke set we can run before rollout. pinging folks.
matt: weights are uploaded to S3, path below. ingestion tested but i bumped ACLs — you might need a role tweak. run `aws s3 ls` to confirm.
```

s3://redwood-weights/prod/nova-small/2026-03-15/nova-small-8bit.pt

```
matt: if CI can't read, grant role `redwood-serving-reader` on that prefix. i can add if you want. :thumbsup:
jules: saw the tokenizer issue — it inserts a leading BOS token id (101) for some prompt shapes which confuses the tool-call arg splitter. short repro: when prompt ends with a newline + json, the tokenizer trims leading `{` after decoding.
jules: quick patch: in the tokenizer config set `strip_leading_bos: true` for this model. add to model-config.yaml under `tokenizer` block.
```

tokenizer:
  name: nova-bytebpe
  strip_leading_bos: true
  special_tokens:
    BOS: "<s>"
    EOS: "</s>"

```
samir: for goldens i can drop a small set (20 prompts) that exercise structured outputs + a tool call (calculator + web_lookup). should we lean more on edge-case arg spacing? also want to include a few long-context continuation cases.
aanya: yes include spacing edge cases + nested JSON args. keep totals small so quick runs in CI (~5–10m).
samir: putting files in `s3://redwood-evals/nova-small/goldens/quick-smoke/` — will attach sample names here shortly.
samir: sample names:
- calculator_space.jsonl
- nested_args.jsonl
- long_context_continuation.jsonl
qa-bot: ran preliminary smoke on staging instance `stg-serve-12` with nova-small weights — tokenizer still produced leading `<s>` in 3/20 cases before config change. after applying `strip_leading_bos: true` patch in local test, 20/20 matched expected. full log:
```

[2026-03-15T18:02:12Z] QA: run start
[2026-03-15T18:03:20Z] case calculator_space.jsonl -> PASS (tool call args parsed)
[2026-03-15T18:03:48Z] case nested_args.jsonl -> FAIL (initial) -> FIXED (post-patch)
[2026-03-15T18:06:05Z] run complete, 20/20 expected after patch

```
matt: i'll update model-config on the staging svc and redeploy weights to the path with a symlink to the current sha. leaving a note in the deployment PR.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: staging/nova-small @ matt (PR #2487). ETA ~6m for rolling replacement.
aanya: awesome. samir can you drop the s3 golden URIs here so i can wire into the regression job? also can we add one tiny test that asserts tool metadata (tool_name, args) are in the structured response JSON?
samir: done — URIs:

```

s3://redwood-evals/nova-small/goldens/quick-smoke/calculator_space.jsonl
s3://redwood-evals/nova-small/goldens/quick-smoke/nested_args.jsonl
s3://redwood-evals/nova-small/goldens/quick-smoke/long_context_continuation.jsonl

```

samir: and yes — add an assert: `response.tools[0].name == "calculator" && typeof response.tools[0].args == 'object'`
jules: one more note — tokenizer vocab has an extra control token `` that sneaks in when decoding streams. recommend we add a decode-filter step in the runtime to strip nonprintables for structured outputs only.
matt: ack. adding decode-filter for structured routes only so free-text gen unaffected.
aanya: perfect. i'll kick off the regression job once deploy is green. if CI green we'll schedule a canary tomorrow morning. thx all :rocket:
matt: remote +1. will follow up in PR with perm changes.
jules: leaving a small unit test in repo `tokenizers/tests/test_strip_bos.py` to cover the case.
qa-bot: final smoke summary attached to PR #2487. tests passing on staging after config tweak. :white_check_mark:
aanya: follow-up: i'll run a 1-hr golden sweep tonight 00:00 UTC. ping if anyone wants earlier window.
matt: i might be offline then, but PR is self-contained.
samir: i'm available for the sweep. will monitor logs and collect failures.
aanya: cool — closing the loop here.
